errors.evidence: The description states that the value for the category "Да, веднъж годишно" is 21.1%, but the chart shows the correct value is 26,7%.

errors.text_span: Секторите се подреждат визуално в низходящ ред, започвайки от най-големия сектор и продължавайки около диаграмата.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly claims that the pie slices are arranged in descending order by size. The chart shows they are not ordered by size; for example, the largest slice (26.7%) is next to the third largest (20.0%), not the second largest (22.2%).
The description claims that a legend is included, but the pie chart has no legend. All labels are placed directly on the chart next to their respective slices.
The word 'веднъж' (once) is misspelled as 'веднаж' in this and three other category labels mentioned in the description.
